mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.name AS name, u.member_type AS memberType, u.admin_level AS adminLevel, DATE(u.created_at) AS joinedDate, l.first_launched_at AS launchedAt, l.launch_count AS launchCount, (SELECT MIN(a.access_hour) FROM stats_access_hourly a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.access_hour >= #{date} AND a.access_hour < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS webAccessedAt FROM users u LEFT JOIN app_launch_daily l ON l.user_id = u.user_id AND l.launch_date = #{date} WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.ban_status <> 'permanent' ORDER BY u.member_type, u.name, u.user_id
SELECT user_id AS userId, MAX(launch_date) AS launchDate FROM app_launch_daily WHERE launch_date <= #{date} GROUP BY user_id

SELECT DATE(access_hour) AS statDate, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS count FROM stats_access_hourly WHERE access_hour >= #{from} AND access_hour < #{toExclusive} GROUP BY DATE(access_hour) ORDER BY statDate
SELECT launch_date AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM app_launch_daily WHERE launch_date >= #{from} AND launch_date < #{toExclusive} GROUP BY launch_date ORDER BY statDate

SELECT HOUR(access_hour) AS hour, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS count FROM stats_access_hourly WHERE access_hour >= #{date} AND access_hour < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY HOUR(access_hour) ORDER BY hour

SELECT stat_week AS statWeek, signup_count AS signupCount, student_count AS studentCount, alumni_count AS alumniCount, captured_at AS capturedAt FROM stats_signup_weekly ORDER BY stat_week DESC LIMIT #{weeks}
